# Landlift Construction & Excavation
> Excavation services in Dorena, Oregon and the south Willamette Valley. Oregon CCB #259368. (541) 214-7764.

## Services
- [Site Preparation](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/landlift-construction-excavation-llc/services/site-prep/): clearing, grubbing, and grading before a build. $2,500–$12,000 depending on acreage and slope
- [Land Clearing](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/landlift-construction-excavation-llc/services/land-clearing/): brush, trees, blackberry, and stump removal. $1,800–$6,000 per acre
- [Grading & Leveling](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/landlift-construction-excavation-llc/services/grading-leveling/): finish grade, drainage slope, pad prep, driveway base. $1,200–$5,000
- [Driveway Construction](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/landlift-construction-excavation-llc/services/driveway-construction/): gravel driveways, base rock, culverts, turnarounds. $3,000–$15,000
- [Drainage Systems](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/landlift-construction-excavation-llc/services/drainage-systems/): french drains, curtain drains, culverts, swales. $1,500–$8,000
- [Foundation Excavation](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/landlift-construction-excavation-llc/services/foundation-excavation/): footings, stem walls, basements, crawlspaces. $3,000–$14,000
- [Septic System Installation](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/landlift-construction-excavation-llc/services/septic-systems/): drainfields, tanks, repairs, DEQ permitted work. $12,000–$30,000 for a full system
- [Utility Trenching](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/landlift-construction-excavation-llc/services/utility-trenching/): water, power, gas, and fiber trenches with proper bedding. $8–$25 per foot
- [Pond Construction](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/landlift-construction-excavation-llc/services/pond-construction/): excavation, clay lining, spillways, water rights considerations. $6,000–$25,000
- [Demolition](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/landlift-construction-excavation-llc/services/demolition/): outbuildings, slabs, mobile homes, debris haul-off. $2,500–$12,000
- [Retaining Walls](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/landlift-construction-excavation-llc/services/retaining-walls/): block, boulder, and timber walls with proper drainage. $45–$110 per face foot
- [Rock & Gravel](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/landlift-construction-excavation-llc/services/rock-gravel-delivery/): base rock, drain rock, road mix, placed and compacted. $400–$1,400 per load placed
- [Culvert Installation](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/landlift-construction-excavation-llc/services/culvert-installation/): driveway culverts, road crossings, headwalls. $1,200–$4,500
- [Erosion Control](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/landlift-construction-excavation-llc/services/erosion-control/): silt fence, straw wattles, seeding, DEQ 1200-C compliance. $800–$4,000
